Edit this single landscape 16:9 illustration. Preserve EXACT man's facial identity, confident smirk, deep tan skin, slicked-back black/silver hair, huge physique, burgundy hunting formalwear, falcon, and hand lifting falcon hood. Preserve achieved soft depth of field and warm/cool lighting. Four specific improvements:
1 COMPOSITION: back the camera off slightly and lower the seated subject within the frame so ALL HAIR AND TOP OF HEAD are completely visible, with a clear 6-8% image-height breathing space ABOVE the highest hair tip. Do not shrink him into a distant landscape; face remains large/readable, adult proportions unchanged. Both hands and bird head fully visible.
2 REMOVE USELESS DETAIL: replace ornate tiny feather-shaped brooch by one simple gold clasp; remove dangling decorative chains from the glove, remove extra tiny straps and decorative waist pouch hardware. Keep only functional glove, falcon hood and its single strap. Merge small cloth crease triangles into main broad flowing folds. Fur in several broad plush groups, bird wing in coherent feather groups with few selective accents, not dense little facets.
3 MATERIAL QUALITY: keep hand-painted anime broad opaque brush finish. Burgundy coat visibly heavy matte velvet through broad deep shadow pools and muted directional nap highlight swaths; sharp thick collar/cuff construction and clear sewn gold edge band. Cream fur soft-volume clumps with selective fluffy broken contour, not hard stone chips. Glove thick dark leather with broad bent-knuckle creases and one economical reflected sheen. Gold clasp one crisp warm highlight against dark side plane. Skin broad clean warm/cool planes, face/eyes precise. No photoreal texture, grain, glossy 3D, surface scratch network or all-over tiny highlights.
4 NEW FOREGROUND: a near-camera dark walnut banquet table corner crosses only lower-left/bottom edge, occupying roughly 10-15% image area. Visible top/side thickness with correct perspective, deliberately out of focus. On that near corner ONE small crystal stem glass of amber wine and a folded dark burgundy napkin, softly blurred and subdued. Table edge partially occludes lower coat/knee to establish tangible near/middle/far depth, NEVER blocks face, arms, hood or falcon. No plate clutter, no flowers or more props. Face/raised fingers/hood and bird eye at focal plane. Middle stone railing mildly soft, distant pines/window more defocused but recognizable, no fog veil. Face first visual focal point; foreground is low contrast. Keep consistent upper-left light and spatial contacts. No writing, borders, watermark.

Skin clean broad planes with restrained warm/cool turns and few tapered colored lines at nose/lids/jaw, no glossy sculpted lip or realistic skin shading.
